figures.finding: Christmas Island has no film agreement, guild or fund of its own: as an Australian territory it is part of 'Australia' in Commonwealth law, so every federal law reaches it unless excluded, and the Fair Work Act (under which Australia's screen awards and agreements are made) applies there; an actor's, writer's, director's and producer's terms there are Australia's.

value.basis: Acts Interpretation Act 1901 (Cth), definition of 'Australia'; Fair Work Act 2009 applies (Fair Work Regulations reg. 1.15DA modifies it only for Western Australian public sector employees)

figures.applies: Christmas Island, Indian Ocean Territory of Australia; all four roles.

sources.said: In the case of the Christmas Islands and the Cocos (Keeling) Islands these Territories are defined as part of the definition of ‘Australia’ in the Acts Interpretation Act 1901 (Cth) and therefore all laws of Australia are applicable to these Territories unless specifically excluded.

The Fair Work Act 2009 (Fair Work Act) in its entirety currently applies to the Western Australian (WA) Government and its public sector employees working in the Territory of Christmas Island (CI) or the Territory of Cocos (Keeling) Islands (CKI).
